leadText: Layla (Japanese: レイラ Layla) is a minor character in Pokémon Horizons: The Series. She is the daughter of Lucius and Rystal, the mother of Diana and in turn Lucca's grandmother and Liko's great-grandmother.
plainText:
Layla (Japanese: レイラ Layla) is a minor character in Pokémon Horizons: The Series. She is the daughter of Lucius and Rystal, the mother of Diana and in turn Lucca's grandmother and Liko's great-grandmother.

==History==
 ]]
===Pre-series===
Diana revealed that Layla was orphaned at a very young age, which meant she had little contact with her family history.

===Pokémon Horizons: The Series===
In Reunion at the Ancient Castle!, she was seen searching for her daughter in a flashback moments before Diana found the mysterious pendant that she would give to Liko years in the future. 

In The Three Explorers and The Wonders of the World!, she was summoned as a baby by at the Crystal Pool alongside her mother, Rystal.

So far, no information about her status in the present day has been revealed.
 
 

==Trivia==
In the BBC iPlayer closed captions, her name is spelled Leila.
